pipeline.name: MeritIQRa One frontend release
pipeline.description: Build, deploy and health-check the dedicated MeritIQRa One frontend service. Source archive must correspond to the specified validated Git commit.

spec.script:
set -euo pipefail
set +x
project=gen-lang-client-0491787004
archive="<+pipeline.variables.source_archive>"
release="<+pipeline.variables.release_tag>"
[[ "$archive" =~ ^gs://gen-lang-client-0491787004_cloudbuild/source/[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+\.tgz$ ]] || { echo "Source must be an approved Cloud Build source archive"; exit 1; }
[[ "$release" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]] || { echo "Release tag must be the full Git commit SHA"; exit 1; }
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
gcloud storage cp "$archive" "$work/source.tgz"
python3 - "$work" <<'PYEXTRACT'
import tarfile,sys,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
with tarfile.open(root/'source.tgz') as tar:
 for m in tar.getmembers():
  if m.issym() or m.islnk() or not (root/m.name).resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):raise ValueError('Unsafe archive')
 tar.extractall(root)
PYEXTRACT
cd "$work"
test -f cloudbuild.yaml
build_id=$(gcloud builds submit "$archive" --project="$project" --gcs-source-staging-dir=gs://gen-lang-client-0491787004_cloudbuild/source --config=cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions="_RELEASE_TAG=$release" --async --format="value(id)")
echo "Cloud Build execution: $build_id"
deadline=$((SECONDS + 2400))
while (( SECONDS < deadline )); do
  status=$(gcloud builds describe "$build_id" --project="$project" --format="value(status)")
  echo "Cloud Build status: $status"
  case "$status" in
    SUCCESS) break ;;
    QUEUED|WORKING|PENDING) sleep 15 ;;
    *) echo "Build did not succeed: $status"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$status" == SUCCESS ]] || { echo "Timed out waiting for build $build_id"; exit 1; }
url=$(gcloud run services describe meritiqra-one-portal --project="$project" --region=asia-south1 --format='value(status.url)')
curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 5 "$url/api/v1/health"
echo "Verified service URL: $url"
